title: Sharp $L^2$ estimates for wave equations with non-integrable speeds
summary: We study the large-time behavior of the displacement for wave equations with non-integrable speeds and zero initial displacement. For initial velocities in $L^2\cap L^1$, we derive an $L^2$ upper bound under a weighted Poincaré inequality and symbol estimates up to order two on the propagation speed. The rate is determined by the speed and its time integral. For these speeds, an additional symbol estimate for the third derivative and the nonzero mean condition on the initial velocity give a lower bound of the same order, obtained without using an explicit formula for the Fourier multiplier.…
